spellcounterstipcard.title: Spell Counters (Tip Card)
spellcounterstipcard.lore:
Some cards in Dark Revelation gain Spell Counters each time a Spell Card is activated. A Spell Counter is a numerical marker on a card, and normally can be represented by coins, glass beads, or any such small item.

It is good to play many of the cards that require Spell Counters if you are going to play any at all. This is because each card on the field will receive its own Spell Counter for each single Spell Card activated.

There are two Field Spell Cards in Dark Revelation that are important to specific theme Decks. These cards are "Necrovalley" for Gravekeeper Decks and "Pandemonium" for Archfiend Decks.

When playing Field Spell Cards like these, it is smart to use cards like "Terraforming" or "An Owl of Luck" because they let you search out the Field Spell Cards you want from your Deck and add them to your hand or place them on top of your Deck.

When you have a few really good cards in your Deck, you want to get to them as fast as possible. This is when you use a technique called Deck Thinning to use one card to remove multiple cards from your Deck.

One card that can do this is the Spell Card "Gather Your Mind". When you activate "Gather Your Mind" you search your Deck for another "Gather Your Mind". After two turns you've removed 3 cards from your Deck in addition to the cards you normally [[Draw a card

settingnormalspellcards.title: Setting Normal Spell Cards
settingnormalspellcards.lore:
You can Set a Normal Spell Card, Ritual Spell Card, or Equip Spell Card face-down in your Spell and Trap Card Zone. But there is only one major reason to do it: to bluff your opponent into thinking you have a Trap Card.

If you are not bluffing, there is very little reason to Set a Spell Card that is not a Quick-Play Spell Card. You can not activate it during your opponent's turn, and while it is face-down on the field it is vulnerable to being destroyed by "Mystical Space Typhoon", etc.

The only other time to Set a Normal Spell Card is when it is safer on the field than it is in your hand and you want to save it for later. This would be the case if your opponent has a card on the field that keeps forcing you to discard.

mainphase2tipcard.title: Main Phase 2 (Tip Card)
mainphase2tipcard.lore:
If you are planning to Set a monster this turn, instead of Summon, you should wait until after your Battle Phase.

That way, if you attack and your opponent has a Flip Effect like "Cyber Jar", your Monster Card will still be in your hand and will not be destroyed. Then you can Set it during Main Phase 2.

If you are planning to attack with your new monster after Summoning it, instead of Setting it, then you usually do it in Main Phase 1. But this can be risky if your opponent has a Trap Card that can destroy your monsters, so sometimes it is still smarter to wait until after your Battle Phase.

Une fois par tour (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez retirer 3 Compteurs Kaiju depuis le Terrain ; l'ATK/DEF de tous les autres monstres sur le Terrain seront divisées par deux.

cybervouivrecuirassee.title: Armored Cybern
cybervouivrecuirassee.ja: アーマード・サイバーン
cybervouivrecuirassee.lore: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control, or 1 Fusion Monster you control that lists "Cyber Dragon" as Fusion Material; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. Once per turn, while equipped to a monster by this effect: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; the equipped monster loses exactly 1000 ATK (even if this card leaves the field), and if it does, destroy that target. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
cybervouivrecuirassee.fr_lore: Une fois par tour, vous pouvez SOIT : ciblez 1 "Cyber Dragon" que vous contrôlez, ou 1 Monstre Fusion que vous contrôlez qui liste "Cyber Dragon" comme Matériel Fusion ; équipez cette carte à la cible, SOIT : déséquipez cette carte et Invoquez-la Spécialement. Une fois par tour, tant qu'elle est équipée à un monstre par cet effet : vous pouvez cibler 1 monstre face recto sur le Terrain ; le monstre équipé perd exactement 1000 ATK (même si cette carte quitte le Terrain), et s'il le fait, détruisez la cible. Si le monstre équipé va être détruit au combat ou par un effet de carte, détruisez cette carte à la place.

worldlegacyscars.fr_lore: Tous les monstres "Mekk-Chevalier" sur le Terrain gagnent 300 ATK/DEF. Vous pouvez bannir 8 monstres "Mekk-Chevalier" de noms différents depuis votre Cimetière et/ou face recto depuis votre Terrain ; envoyez toute la main de votre adversaire et Extra Deck au Cimetière.

dueltransdimensionnel.title: Cross-Dimensional Duel
dueltransdimensionnel.ja: {{Ruby|競|きょう}}{{Ruby|闘|とう}}－クロス・ディメンション
dueltransdimensionnel.fr_lore: Ciblez 1 monstre "Rouages Ancients" que vous contrôlez ; bannissez-le. Durant la prochaine Standby Phase, renvoyez le monstre banni sur le Terrain, et si vous le faites, son ATK devient le double de son ATK d'origine jusqu'à la fin de ce tour. Si min. 1 "Golem Rouages Ancients" ou "Golem Rouages Ancients - Frappe Ultime" que vous contrôlez va être détruit au combat ou par un effet de carte, vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière à la place.

heavymetalraiders.fr_lore: La première fois que chaque monstre TÉNÈBRES Machine que vous contrôlez va être détruit au combat chaque tour, il n'est pas détruit, et si vous avez reçu des dommages de combat du combat, il gagne autant d'ATK après le calcul des dommages, et garde ce gain d'ATK tant que cette carte est sur le Terrain. Une fois par tour, si un monstre que vous contrôlez qui était TÉNÈBRES Machine à l'origine détruit une ou plusieurs cartes sur le Terrain au combat ou par un effet de carte : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre TÉNÈBRES Machine depuis votre main.

ciguefarstar.title: Trickstar Corobane
ciguefarstar.ja: トリックスター・キャロベイン
ciguefarstar.fr_lore: Si vous ne contrôlez aucun monstre, ou si tous les monstres que vous contrôlez sont des monstres "Farstar" : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte depuis votre main. Durant la Damage Step, lorsque votre monstre "Farstar" combat un monstre de l'adversaire (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez envoyer cette carte depuis votre main au Cimetière ; jusqu'à la fin de ce tour, le monstre que vous contrôlez gagne une ATK égale à son ATK d'origine. Vous ne pouvez utiliser qu'1 effet de "Ciguë Farstar" par tour, et uniquement une fois le tour.

Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Exécuteur Revendetterreur" qu'une fois par tour.

Vous ne pouvez pas ajouter d'autres monstres du même Attribut à votre main par l'effet de "Cynet Codec" ce tour, et vous ne pouvez activer l'effet de "Cynet Codec" qu'une fois par Chaîne.

betecristallineultimeescarbouclederubis.lore: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell: You can Special Summon this card, then you can Special Summon as many "Advanced Crystal Beast" Monster Cards as possible from your Spell & Trap Zones. You can only use this effect of "Advanced Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle" once per turn.
betecristallineultimeescarbouclederubis.fr_lore: Si "Ténèbres Ultimes" n'est pas dans une Zone Terrain, envoyez ce monstre au Cimetière. Si cette carte face recto est détruite dans une Zone Monstre, vous pouvez la placer face recto dans votre Zone Magie & Piège comme Magie Continue au lieu de l'envoyer au Cimetière. Tant que cette carte est traitée comme Magie Continue : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte, puis vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement autant de Cartes Monstre "Bête Cristalline Ultime" que possible depuis vos Zones Magie & Piège. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Bête Cristalline Ultime : Escarboucle de Rubis" qu'une fois par tour.

betegribouillagetyranno.ja: らくがきじゅう－てらの
betegribouillagetyranno.lore: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Dinosaur monster. During the Main Phase, if a Dinosaur monster is on the field, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Doodle Beast - Tyranno" once per turn. If this card is Normal Summoned: You can destroy 1 monster on the field, then, if this card was Tribute Summoned by Tributing a "Doodle Beast" monster(s), it gains ATK equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.
betegribouillagetyranno.fr_lore: Vous pouvez Invoquer par Sacrifice cette carte en Sacrifiant 1 monstre Dinosaure. Durant la Main Phase, si un monstre Dinosaure est sur le Terrain, vous pouvez (Effet Rapide) : immédiatement après la résolution de cet effet, Invoquez par Sacrifice cette carte depuis votre main. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Bête Gribouillage - Tyranno" qu'une fois par tour. Si cette carte est Invoquée Normalement : vous pouvez détruire 1 monstre sur le Terrain, puis, si cette carte a été Invoquée par Sacrifice en Sacrifiant un ou plusieurs monstres "Bête Gribouillage", elle gagne une ATK égale à la moitié de l'ATK du monstre détruit sur le Terrain.

You can only use this effect of "Protection of the Elements" once per turn.

Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "La Protection des Éléments" qu'une fois par tour.

He is petty, and only picks fights he thinks he can win, so he often falls to unexpected counterattacks. He grows uninhibited when he's got friends around, which leads to misunderstandings, and he still hasn't figured out that he can't do anything on his own.

Roublard, il évite toujours les combats qu'il n'est pas sûr de remporter, mais se fait souvent avoir par une contre-attaque surprise. Il perd toute inhibition quand il est accompagné de ses amis, ce qui cause de nombreux malentendus, et il n'a toujours pas réalisé qu'il ne sait absolument rien faire par lui-même.

You can only use each of the following effects of "Borrelcode Dragon" once per turn. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card that was Link Summoned using 3 monsters as material battles an opponent's monster: You can destroy all monsters on the field. curduchaos.lore: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by card effect. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead. Vous pouvez bannir 1 monstre TÉNÈBRES depuis votre main ou Cimetière ; Invoquez Spécialement cette carte depuis votre main, et aussi, vous ne pouvez pas Invoquer Spécialement de monstres (Monstres Synchro LUMIÈRE ou TÉNÈBRES exclus) depuis l'Extra Deck le reste de ce tour. Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement : vous pouvez cibler 1 de vos "Carapace du Chaos" bannis ; Invoquez-le Spécialement.

alertedinomorphia.title: Dinomorphia Alert
alertedinomorphia.ja: ダイノルフィア・アラート
alertedinomorphia.lore: Pay half your LP; Special Summon up to 2 "Dinomorphia" monsters from your GY whose total Levels equal 8 or less, but you cannot declare an attack with them this turn, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except "Dinomorphia" monsters. When your opponent activates a card or effect, while your LP are 2000 or less: You can banish this card from your GY; you take no effect damage from your opponent's card effects this turn. You can only activate 1 "Dinomorphia Alert" per turn.

Lorsque votre adversaire active une carte ou un effet, tant que vos LP sont inférieurs ou égaux à 2000 : vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière ; ce tour, vous ne recevez aucun dommage d'effet des effets de carte de votre adversaire. nemleriareveuse.lore: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your face-up Extra Deck) by having no cards in your Extra Deck, except "Dreaming Nemleria". You can only Special Summon "Dreaming Nemleria(s)" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: For every 3 of your face-down banished cards, you can banish up to 1 card from your opponent's field and/or GY, face-down, then shuffle 1 of your face-down banished cards into your Deck for each card you banished by this effect.
nemleriareveuse.fr_lore: Ni Invocable Normalement ni Posable Normalement. Uniquement Invocable Spécialement (depuis votre Extra Deck face recto) en n'ayant aucune carte dans votre Extra Deck ("Nemleria Rêveuse" exclu). Vous ne pouvez Invoquer Spécialement un ou plusieurs "Nemleria Rêveuse" qu'une fois par tour. Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement : pour toutes les 3 de vos cartes bannies face verso, vous pouvez bannir face verso max. 1 carte depuis le Terrain et/ou Cimetière de votre adversaire, puis mélangez 1 de vos cartes bannies face verso dans votre Deck pour chaque carte que vous avez bannie par cet effet.

batosushigunkanshari.lore: Finally got to visit that [[Gunkan Sushipyard Seaside Supper Spot
batosushigunkanshari.fr_lore: J'ai finalement pu me rendre dans ce port dédié aux Batosuhis Gunkan que je voulais visiter depuis un certain temps ! Le "Shari" premium ici est limité à 2000 Batosushis par an et utilise du riz spécialement préparé pour lui donner une saveur particulière qu'on ne trouve nulle part ailleurs. L'atmosphère était également géniale. Le Batosushi Gunkan qui m'a été servi avait un équilibre parfait entre vinaigre, nigiri, brillance et forme, digne d'un artisanat sans égal. Le propriétaire a mentionné son intention d'introduire dans un avenir proche du vinaigre rouge EDO-FRONT qui a un parfum riche mais doux en même temps. Je suis impatient de pouvoir y goûter. Cependant, j'ai été déçu à cause du bruit environnant de la mer... Je lui donne 4 étoiles en espérant que des améliorations seront apportées à l'avenir.

portecelestedumikanko.title: Heavenly Gate of the Mikanko
portecelestedumikanko.ja: {{Ruby|天|あまつ}}{{Ruby|御巫|みかんこ}}の{{Ruby|闔|とびら}}
portecelestedumikanko.lore: While you control a monster that is equipped with an Equip Card, all monsters your opponent controls that can attack must attack monsters equipped with Equip Cards. If your "Mikanko" monster battles, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step. At the end of the Damage Step, if your "Mikanko" monster attacked: You can send 1 Equip Card you control to the GY; it can make another attack on a monster in a row.
portecelestedumikanko.fr_lore: Tant que vous contrôlez un monstre qui est équipé avec une Carte d'Équipement, tous les monstres contrôlés par votre adversaire qui peuvent attaquer doivent attaquer des monstres équipés avec une Carte d'Équipement. Si votre monstre "Mikanko" combat, votre adversaire ne peut activer ni de cartes ni d'effets jusqu'à la fin de la Damage Step. À la fin de la Damage Step, si votre monstre "Mikanko" a attaqué : vous pouvez envoyer 1 Carte d'Équipement que vous contrôlez au Cimetière ; il peut faire une autre attaque à la suite sur un monstre.

zephyrcelestemiradora.title: Heavenly Zephyr - Miradora
zephyrcelestemiradora.ja: {{Ruby|風|かぜ}}の{{Ruby|天|てん}}{{Ruby|翼|よく}}ミラドーラ
zephyrcelestemiradora.sc: 风之天翼 米勒德拉
zephyrcelestemiradora.lore: The activation and effect of this card's effects cannot be negated. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) with 2000 or more ATK from the Extra Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand: You can target 1 face-up opponent's monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; neither player can activate that monster's effects while this monster is face-up on the field. You can only use each effect of "Heavenly Zephyr - Miradora" once per turn.
zephyrcelestemiradora.fr_lore: L'activation et effet des effets de cette carte ne peuvent pas être annulés. Si votre adversaire Invoque Spécialement un ou plusieurs monstres avec min. 2000 ATK depuis l'Extra Deck (sauf durant la Damage Step) : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte depuis votre main. Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement depuis la main : vous pouvez cibler 1 monstre face recto de l'adversaire qui a été Invoqué Spécialement depuis l'Extra Deck ; aucun joueur ne peut activer les effets du monstre tant que ce monstre est face recto sur le Terrain. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Zéphyr Céleste - Miradora" qu'une fois par tour.

For the rest of this turn, that 1 monster gains 800 ATK while battling an opponent's monster and can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn.
heregoessomething.fr_lore: Une fois par Duel, vous pouvez activer cette Compétence au début de votre Battle Phase, tant que vous contrôlez exactement 1 monstre "HÉROS Élémentaire" (et aucun autre monstre). Le reste de ce tour, le monstre gagne 800 ATK en combattant un monstre de l'adversaire et il peut attaquer une fois tous les monstres contrôlés par votre adversaire, et aussi, vous ne pouvez pas Invoquer Spécialement de monstres le reste de ce tour.

majestehyperion.lore: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by banishing 1 "The Agent" monster from your hand, field, or GY. You can only Special Summon "Majesty Hyperion" once per turn this way. Any battle damage you take from battles involving your Fairy monsters is also inflicted to your opponent. Once per turn: You can banish 1 Fairy monster from your hand or GY, then target 1 card in either GY; banish it. Les dommages de combat que vous recevez de combats impliquant vos monstres Elfe sont aussi infligés à votre adversaire. Une fois par tour : vous pouvez bannir 1 monstre Elfe depuis votre main ou Cimetière, puis ciblez 1 carte dans l'un des Cimetières ; bannissez-la. Si "Le Sanctuaire Céleste" est sur le Terrain ou dans l'un des Cimetières, vous pouvez utiliser cet effet max. deux fois par tour.

jeuxdedesumomusical.lore: 2 Level 6 monstersAt the start of your opponent's Battle Phase: If this card is in the Main Monster Zone, roll a six-sided die and move this card directly to that many (1 to 6) Main Monster Zones clockwise, and if a monster is already in that zone it moves to, attach that monster to this card as material. (Transférez ses Matériels à cette carte.) Si cet effet fait que le nombre de Matériels de ce monstre est supérieur à 6, vous gagnez le Duel. Si cette carte ne peut pas être déplacée ou que le monstre dans la zone dans laquelle elle est déplacée ne peut pas être attaché, envoyez cette carte au Cimetière.

Le Niveau de chaque Jeton est augmenté par le nombre de Compteurs Otoshidamashi sur cette carte lorsqu'il est Invoqué, et aussi, l'ATK/DEF de chaque Jeton sont égales à son Niveau x 500 lorsqu'il est Invoqué. While that Token is in the Monster Zone, the player who Summoned it cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Swordsoul Assessment" once per turn.

Si cette carte est bannie : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 "Jeton Âmépée" (Wyrm/Syntoniseur/EAU/Niveau 4/ATK 0/DEF 0). Tant que le Jeton est dans la Zone Monstre, le joueur qui l'a Invoqué ne peut pas Invoquer Spécialement de monstres (Monstres Synchro exclus) depuis l'Extra Deck. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Évaluation Âmépée" qu'une fois par tour.

lesroidssontbien.lore: "Vehicroid Connection Zone" can be used to Fusion Summon any "roid" monsters from your Extra Deck. All "roid" monsters whose original Level is 6 or lower can be Normal Summoned/Set without Tributing. If a non-Fusion "roid" Machine monster you control whose original Level is 6 or lower attacks an opponent's monster, it gains ATK equal to its own Level x 100 during the Damage Step only. If you control a non-Machine monster, flip this card over.
lesroidssontbien.fr_lore: "Zone de Connexion Véhicroid" peut être utilisé pour Invoquer par Fusion un monstre "roid" depuis votre Extra Deck. Tous les monstres "roid" dont le Niveau d'origine est max. 6 peuvent être Invoqués/Posés Normalement sans Sacrifice. Si un monstre non-Fusion "roid" Machine que vous contrôlez dont le Niveau d'origine est max. 6 attaque un monstre de l'adversaire, il gagne une ATK égale à son propre Niveau x 100 durant la Damage Step uniquement. Si vous contrôlez un monstre non-Machine, retournez cette carte.

etrangerbigbang.lore: If a monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Durant votre Battle Phase ou la Main Phase de votre adversaire, si le Niveau de cette carte est min. 8 (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez détruire 1 autre carte sur le Terrain, et si vous le faites, le Niveau de cette carte devient 5. goblinbikersgonewild.lore: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Goblin" monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Goblin Bikers Gone Wild" once per turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 card on the field; attach it to 1 "Goblin" Xyz Monster you control.

Si cette carte est Invoquée Normalement ou Spécialement : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre "Gobelin" de max. Niveau 4 depuis votre Deck. Si cette carte est envoyée au Cimetière : vous pouvez cibler 1 carte sur le Terrain ; attachez-la à 1 Monstre Xyz "Gobelin" que vous contrôlez.

tempuradelafortuneebi.lore: We went to EDO-FRONT, which has been the talk of the town. The scale of the Tempura here is not only large but also so beautifully shaped that it has earned the nickname of "Golden Tempura". The state-of-the-art facilities and the atmosphere of other cultures are all in the harbor, but there is also a mellow, nostalgic aroma in the air, and the occasional crackle of the crackling sounds will lift your spirits. We have been looking forward to this cruise for a year, but I think [[Level 3 Monster Cards
tempuradelafortuneebi.fr_lore: Nous sommes allés à EDO-FRONT, centre de toutes les attentions en ville. Le tempura là-bas est non seulement gigantesque, mais aussi tellement élégant qu'il a gagné le surnom de "Tempura d'or". L'équipement ultramoderne et l'atmosphère multiculturelle sont omniprésents dans le port, où un arôme doux et nostalgique flotte dans l'air. Les bruits de crépitement occasionnels vous remonteront le moral. Ça fait plus d'un an que nous voulions y aller, mais je pense qu'il ne mérite que 3 étoiles.

The state-of-the-art facilities and the atmosphere of other cultures are all in the harbor, but there is also a mellow, nostalgic aroma in the air, and the occasional crackle of the crackling sounds will lift your spirits. We have been looking forward to this cruise for a year, but I think [[Level 3 Monster Cards
tempuraoffortuneebi.fr_lore: Nous sommes allés à EDO-FRONT, centre de toutes les attentions en ville. Le tempura là-bas est non seulement gigantesque, mais aussi tellement élégant qu'il a gagné le surnom de "Tempura d'or". L'équipement ultramoderne et l'atmosphère multiculturelle sont omniprésents dans le port, où un arôme doux et nostalgique flotte dans l'air. Les bruits de crépitement occasionnels vous remonteront le moral. Ça fait plus d'un an que nous voulions y aller, mais je pense qu'il ne mérite que 3 étoiles.

icisontdesdragons.lore: Special Summon 1 "Dragon Ruler" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Xyz Summon 1 "Dragon Ruler" Xyz Monster using only "Dragon Ruler" monsters you control. You can only use 1 "Here There Be Dragons" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

Durant votre Main Phase : vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière, puis ciblez un nombre de votre choix de vos monstres "Maître Dragon" bannis d'Attributs différents ; renvoyez-les au Cimetière. Vous ne pouvez utiliser qu'1 effet de "Ici Sont des Dragons" par tour, et uniquement une fois le tour.

k9xforcedrelease.lore: During the Main Phase: Target 1 "K9" Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "K9" Xyz Monster with a different name, by using that monster you control (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials to the Summoned monster), then you can destroy 1 card your opponent controls. À la fin de la Battle Phase, si votre monstre "K9" a combattu ce tour : vous pouvez Poser cette carte depuis votre Cimetière. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "K9-X Libération Forcée" qu'une fois par tour.

Si vous Invoquez Spécialement un ou plusieurs Monstres Fusion "HÉROS" non-FEU (sauf durant la Damage Step) : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte depuis votre Cimetière (si elle y était lorsque l'Invocation est résolue) ou main (même si elle n'y était pas), mais bannissez-la lorsqu'elle quitte le Terrain. synchrofellowship.fr_lore: Ajoutez 2 monstres depuis votre Deck à votre main (1 "Robot Synchronique" et 1 monstre qui mentionne "Robot Guerrier" ou "Dragon Poussière d'Étoile"), puis défaussez 1 carte. Vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière, puis ciblez 1 Monstre Synchro que vous contrôlez ; réduisez son Niveau de 1, puis vous pouvez Invoquer Normalement 1 monstre "Synchronique" durant votre Main Phase ce tour, en plus de votre Invocation/Pose Normale (vous ne pouvez gagner cet effet qu'une fois par tour). Vous ne pouvez activer qu'1 "Camaraderie Synchro" par tour.

herissonaboulonsdancrage.title: Anchorbolt Hedgehog
herissonaboulonsdancrage.ja: アンカーボルト・ヘッジホッグ
herissonaboulonsdancrage.lore: If you control "Junk Warrior" or a monster that mentions it, except "Anchorbolt Hedgehog", and this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Anchorbolt Hedgehog" once per turn.
herissonaboulonsdancrage.fr_lore: Si vous contrôlez "Robot Guerrier" ou un monstre qui le mentionne ("Hérisson à Boulons d'Ancrage" exclu), et que cette carte est dans votre Cimetière (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte en Position de Défense, et aussi, vous ne pouvez pas Invoquer Spécialement (Monstres Synchro exclus) depuis l'Extra Deck le reste de ce tour. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Hérisson à Boulons d'Ancrage" qu'une fois par tour.

Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement : vous pouvez cibler un nombre de cartes dans le Terrain et/ou Cimetière de votre adversaire, inférieur ou égal au nombre de vos monstres bannis avec 2500 ATK ou DEF ; renvoyez-les à la main. Les monstres contrôlés par votre adversaire perdent 2500 ATK durant la Battle Phase uniquement.

activationdoomzadrasteia.lore: The first time the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use each of the following effects of "DoomZ Command "A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A."" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can destroy the equipped monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "DoomZ" monster in Defense Position, except the destroyed monster, from your hand, GY, or banishment. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; equip it with this card, then take damage equal to the equipped monster's Level/Rank x 100.
activationdoomzadrasteia.fr_lore: La première fois que le monstre équipé va être détruit au combat chaque tour, il n'est pas détruit. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chacun des effets suivants de "Activation DoomZ "A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A."" qu'une fois par tour. Durant votre Main Phase : vous pouvez détruire le monstre équipé, et si vous le faites, Invoquez Spécialement 1 monstre "DoomZ" (le monstre détruit exclu) en Position de Défense depuis votre main, Cimetière ou bannissement. Si cette carte est dans votre Cimetière : vous pouvez cibler 1 monstre face recto que vous contrôlez ; équipez-le avec cette carte, puis recevez des dommages égaux au Niveau/Rang du monstre équipé x 100.

You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this effect, except in face-down Defense Position.

Maillon 3 de la Chaîne (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez changer cette carte face verso en Position de Défense face recto ; annulez l'activation des cartes et effets de votre adversaire activés avant cette carte dans cette Chaîne, et si vous le faites, détruisez-les. basicrulechange.title: Basic Rule Change ①
basicrulechange.ja: {{Ruby|基|き}}{{Ruby|本|ほん}}ルール{{Ruby|変|へん}}{{Ruby|更|こう}}{{Ruby|点|てん}}①
basicrulechange.lore:
The New Expert Rules have been further updated. The most important changes are listed below.

★ Losing when your Deck runs outA player loses the Duel if they would draw a card (including by a Spell or effect) when their Deck is empty.

★ 6 or more cards in the handThe maximum number of cards in the hand is restricted to 6. If there are 7 or more cards in the hand during the End Phase, you must discard until there are 6 cards left.

★ 15 cards in the Side DeckUntil now there were 10 cards in the Side Deck, but the New Expert Rules expand this to 15.

juniorruleintroductionvol1.lore:
The Junior Rules are a beginner-friendly set of rules. Try the Junior Rules while you're stil getting used the game. If you master the Junior Rules, try out the New Expert Rules!

★ Turn flowEach of the ① to ⑥ below occur once per turn. Alternate progressing through these steps throughout the Duel.① Draw Phase……Draw 1 card. You lose if you cannot draw.② Standby Phase……A phase in which you prepare particular cards③ Main Phase 1……Normal Summon monsters, Set/use Spells & Traps, etc.④ Battle Phase……Attack opposing monsters and the opponent⑤ Main Phase 2……Normal Summon monsters, Set/use Spells & Traps, etc.⑥ End Phase……The turn ends

* Monster Card Zone…… You can Set up to 5 Monster Cards. Attack Position is upright, Defense Position is sideways.

juniorruleintroductionvol6.lore:
⑤ Main Phase 2…… Same as Main Phase 1It is the same as Main Phase 1 detailed in ③, but you must abide by the limitations on the number of cards that can be played.For example, if you Set a Trap Card in Main Phase 1, you cannot Set a Spell/Trap Card during that same turn.Likewise, you can only Normal Summon 1 monster once per turn.

⑥ End Phase…… End of the turnIf there are 7 or more cards in your hand, discard until you have 6 cards left.Declare the end of your turn, then it becomes your opponent's turn.

⑦ End of the DuelIf your opponent's Life Points become 0, or your opponent is unable to draw a card from their Deck, the Duel ends and you win.Also, if your Life Points become 0 at the same time, the Duel is a draw.The player who wins 2 Duels, or wins 1 and draws 2 Duels, of the 3 Duels is declared the winner.

chainnewexpertrule.title: Chain (New Expert Rule)
chainnewexpertrule.lore:
Traps, Quick-Play Spells, etc. can be played in response to your opponent using a Spell or monster effect. This is explained by the basic concepts of a Chain.

The first card played, Card A, is placed as Chain Link 1. If no cards are played in response, Card A's effect is applied.

However, if someone plays Card B in response, that Card B is placed as Chain Link 2, above Chain Link 1.

You can stack up as many cards as you would like, then if nobody plays any more cards, the Chain resolves backwards.

juniorrulenewexpertrule.title: Junior Rule (New Expert Rule)
juniorrulenewexpertrule.lore:
The Junior Rules are designed for beginners. However, these basic rules are not that different to the New Expert Rules. Only a few of the rules differ.

● High Level monsters do not require Tributes to Normal Summon.● Spell Cards and Trap Cards must be placed face-down before they can be used.(Trap Cards cannot be used until the next turn, and Spell Cards cannot be used until your next turn)You can only place up to 1 Spell Card or Trap Card face-down per turn.● You can only have 1 Spell or Trap Card on your side of the field.● Quick-Play Spells cannot be used from the hand.● Effect Monsters (Quick Effects) cannot be used from the hand.

lesbetessacreesduspectrechaotique.fr: Les Bêtes Sacrées du Spectre Chaotique
lesbetessacreesduspectrechaotique.ja: {{Ruby|混|こん}}{{Ruby|沌|とん}}の{{Ruby|三|さん}}{{Ruby|幻|げん}}{{Ruby|魔|ま}}
lesbetessacreesduspectrechaotique.lore: 3 Level 10 monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/SetMust be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards you control to the GY. You can only Special Summon "The Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. The first two times this card on the field would be destroyed by card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Once per Chain, up to thrice per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects (until the end of this turn), then you can gain LP equal to half that monster's ATK.
lesbetessacreesduspectrechaotique.fr_lore: 3 monstres de Niveau 10 qui ne peuvent pas être Invoqués/Posés NormalementUniquement soit Invocable par Fusion soit Invocable Spécialement (depuis votre Extra Deck) en envoyant les cartes ci-dessus que vous contrôlez au Cimetière. Vous ne pouvez Invoquer Spécialement "Les Bêtes Sacrées du Spectre Chaotique" qu'une fois par tour de cette façon, peu importe la méthode que vous utilisez. Les deux premières fois que cette carte sur le Terrain va être détruite par un effet de carte chaque tour, elle n'est pas détruite. Une fois par Chaîne, max. trois fois par tour (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez cibler 1 monstre face recto contrôlé par votre adversaire ; annulez ses effets (jusqu'à la fin de ce tour), puis vous pouvez gagner des LP égaux à la moitié de l'ATK du monstre.

If this card is Special Summoned: You can place up to 3 Synchro Monsters with different names from your Extra Deck and/or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as face-up Continuous Spells, and Special Summon 1 "Arc Token" (Machine/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the number placed, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. legrandbanditgalant.lore: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing monsters in your hand and/or your opponent's field, while you control no monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Great Gallant Bandit" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card effect in the hand, GY, or banishment, and you control this Normal Summoned/Set card (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal your entire hand; change all monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position.
legrandbanditgalant.fr_lore: Vous pouvez Invoquer par Sacrifice face recto cette carte en Sacrifiant des monstres dans votre main et/ou Terrain de votre adversaire, tant que vous ne contrôlez aucun monstre. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chacun des effets suivants de "Le Grand Bandit Galant" qu'une fois par tour. Lorsque votre adversaire active un effet de carte dans la main, Cimetière ou bannissement, et que vous contrôlez cette carte Invoquée/Posée Normalement (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez annuler l'effet, et si vous le faites, détruisez la carte. Durant la Battle Phase (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez révéler toute votre main ; changez tous les monstres contrôlés par votre adversaire en Position de Défense.

golemimmondices.title: Garbage Golem
golemimmondices.ja: ガーベージ・ゴーレム
golemimmondices.lore: If you control a monster with 0 ATK or DEF: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can reveal 3 Xyz Monsters in your Extra Deck with different Ranks, then target 1 other card on the field; destroy both it and this card. You can banish this card from your GY; detach 1 material from a monster you control, then you can Special Summon 1 monster with 0 ATK or DEF from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Garbage Golem" once per turn.
golemimmondices.fr_lore: Si vous contrôlez un monstre avec 0 ATK ou DEF : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte depuis votre main. Vous pouvez révéler 3 Monstres Xyz dans votre Extra Deck de Rangs différents, puis ciblez 1 autre carte sur le Terrain ; détruisez-la ainsi que cette carte. Vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière ; détachez 1 Matériel d'un monstre que vous contrôlez, puis vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre avec 0 ATK ou DEF depuis votre main ou Cimetière. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Golem Immondices" qu'une fois par tour.

blueeyeswhitedragonanimerushduel.lore: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

lesserdragonanimerushduel.title: Lesser Dragon (anime Rush Duel)
lesserdragonanimerushduel.lore: A minor dragon incapable of breathing fire.

lizardsoldieranimerushduel.title: Lizard Soldier (anime Rush Duel)
lizardsoldieranimerushduel.lore: A beast soldier derived from dragons, it is small for a Dragon Type. Moving very quickly, this monster is an excellent strategist.

blazingchestnutanime.lore: [REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Warrior Type [[Monster Card

cursedswordoftheeastanime.title: Cursed Sword of the East (anime)
cursedswordoftheeastanime.lore: [REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 8 Warrior Type [[Monster Card

dragoriteanime.title: Dragorite (anime)
dragoriteanime.lore: A dragon that spawned from an underground mineral vein. It uses the energy from an unknown ore as a power source for battling. The ultra-hard blows it delivers are incredibly effective!

dragonssageanime.title: Dragon's Sage (anime)
dragonssageanime.lore: A young priestess from a bloodline of ancient dragons. She offers daily prayers for the peace of her people. It is said her clear eyes have the power to alter the fate of those reflected in them.

fireguardiananime.title: Fire Guardian (anime)
fireguardiananime.lore: The gatekeeper standing watch over the path to the Fire Dragon Kingdom. Those who cannot withstand its breath do not have the right to go past it.

dragonbatanime.title: Dragon Bat (anime)
dragonbatanime.lore: Even scholars argue whether this mysterious creature is a bird or a beast. When flying in swarms, they somewhat resemble dragons, so it is possible that's what they are.

dracothetinyanime.title: Draco the Tiny (anime)
dracothetinyanime.lore: A small peace-loving dragon that will affectionately approach you if fed some nuts. The ring on its necklace is rumored to hold a great secret.

ancientturtleprotectoranime.title: Ancient Turtle Protector (anime)
ancientturtleprotectoranime.lore: A respecter of tradition that reminisces about times long past. Those really were the good old days.

bindingchainanimerushduel.title: Binding Chain (anime Rush Duel)
bindingchainanimerushduel.lore: The mystic links of this chain can rob enemies of their power.

scoopscooteranime.title: Scoop Scooter (anime)
scoopscooteranime.lore: Delivers the morning edition before breakfast! Also delivers the evening edition before breakfast!

stockthenoodleninjaanime.title: Stock the Noodle Ninja (anime)
stockthenoodleninjaanime.lore: A ninja who prides himself on being al dente. He constantly trains himself to reach the hardness of steel wire. He isn't great with water techniques.

lamoonthepartyprincessanime.title: LaMoon the Party Princess (anime)
lamoonthepartyprincessanime.lore: A sorceress that has escaped dull, everyday life. She uses lunar magic to captivate affluent men. Besties with Kanan the Sword Diva.

kananthesworddivaanime.title: Kanan the Sword Diva (anime)
kananthesworddivaanime.lore: A swordswoman who leads the vanguard in the entertainment district. Even in full makeup, she always carries her sword and shield. Friends with Bubbly Elf.

bubblyelfanime.title: Bubbly Elf (anime)
bubblyelfanime.lore: This girl is delicate no more. While poised and collected, she's always down to party. Pager pals with LaMoon the Party Princess.

beastgearmotowolfanime.title: Beast Gear Moto Wolf (anime)
beastgearmotowolfanime.lore: A beast continually looting citizens of their food and gasoline. He might appear to be a lone wolf, but he believes that evil is right and does everything he can for his gang. For such a wicked criminal, one can't help but wonder why his distant howls touch the heart so deeply.

beastgeargyrojackalanime.title: Beast Gear Gyro Jackal (anime)
beastgeargyrojackalanime.lore: A beast that drives around wildly, always in search of some fun. He is petty, and only picks fights he thinks he can win, so he often falls to unexpected counterattacks. He grows uninhibited when he's got friends around, which leads to misunderstandings, and he still hasn't figured out that he can't do anything on his own.

beastgearbuggydoganime.title: Beast Gear Buggy Dog (anime)
beastgearbuggydoganime.lore: A canine that extorts scraps of dog food from an old man. He is full of himself and acts tough, but has no real convictions. He used to hate living life on a leash, but now he feels that he was happier just to have an owner.

megazowleranimerushduel.title: Megazowler (anime Rush Duel)
megazowleranimerushduel.lore: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur!

ghoulishgalanime.title: Ghoulish Gal (anime)
ghoulishgalanime.lore: A presence passes behind your back in the basement of the boy's bathroom. But you cannot turn around until you have finished your business. There is no return for an early peek...

dollofdreadanime.title: Doll of Dread (anime)
dollofdreadanime.lore: I always get sleep paralysis while sleeping in my dressing room... And inside that the dark, when I look towards my pillow...

thethinginthepurplemirroranime.title: The Thing In the Purple Mirror (anime)
thethinginthepurplemirroranime.en: The Thing In the Purple Mirror (anime)
thethinginthepurplemirroranime.lore: Folks...do you know the term "purple mirror"? If you know, be careful. If you remember it passed 20 years, then you...

psystagebounceranime.title: Psy Stage Bouncer (anime)
psystagebounceranime.lore: The psychic menace has been growing in recent years, and a crack team of bodyguards has been entrusted to protect Psychic Diva, the key to solving it all.

concertcostumecreatoranime.title: Concert Costume Creator (anime)
concertcostumecreatoranime.lore: A designer that uses her psychic talents to make costumes for shows. She is stubborn and won't accept jobs from artists she doesn't like.

royalrebelsfanaticanime.title: Royal Rebel's Fanatic (anime)
royalrebelsfanaticanime.lore: A girl who has trouble making eye contact when talking with others. She seeks friends and true love.

keytarkidanime.title: Keytar Kid (anime)
keytarkidanime.lore: The youngest member of the band, she's often teased by Romic n' Roller, but everyone recognizes her talents. She dreams of the day she'll play on stage with her bandmates as a quintet.

vishwarrandianimerushduel.title: Vishwar Randi (anime Rush Duel)
vishwarrandianimerushduel.lore: This lady warrior with unquenchable bloodlust serves the forces of darkness.

gaiathefierceknightanimerushduel.title: Gaia The Fierce Knight (anime Rush Duel)
gaiathefierceknightanimerushduel.en: Gaia The Fierce Knight (anime Rush Duel)
gaiathefierceknightanimerushduel.lore: A knight whose horse travels faster than the wind. His battle-charge is a force to be reckoned with.

machineattackeranimerushduel.title: Machine Attacker (anime Rush Duel)
machineattackeranimerushduel.lore: This machine, created to lead charges into enemy territory, mows down enemies by rushing.

dragonknightofdarknessanime.title: Dragon Knight of Darkness (anime)
dragonknightofdarknessanime.lore: A dragon knight leading a dark army. His merciless attacks have unparalleled strength, and the cursed sword he wields devours the souls of his foes and makes him stronger.

jetbarracudaanime.title: Jet Barracuda (anime)
jetbarracudaanime.lore: This creature uses jet propulsion to charge in shocking speeds. Some wonder whether it even is a fish.

heatdartfishanime.title: Heat Dartfish (anime)
heatdartfishanime.lore: A fish with a proboscis that heats up when attacking. Its mild flavor makes it a true delicacy.

thunderbeetlesnareanime.title: Thunderbeetle Snare (anime)
thunderbeetlesnareanime.lore: Popular, unique, and always energetic.It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.

thunderbeetlehighhatanime.title: Thunderbeetle Highhat (anime)
thunderbeetlehighhatanime.lore: A multifaceted older brother type.It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.

scarechairgearanime.title: Scarechair Gear (anime)
scarechairgearanime.lore: A mechanical chair that is easy to mass produce. It is not as comfortable to sit in as the organic chairs from before.

scarechairboneanime.title: Scarechair Bone (anime)
scarechairboneanime.lore: One of the earliest organic chairs said to be made by a family of artisans. Has a distinctive feel when sat upon.

scarechairsaberanime.title: Scarechair Saber (anime)
scarechairsaberanime.lore: A masterpiece organic chair made by a family of artisans at the peak of their craft. Extremely comfortable.

cosmoscallionanime.title: Cosmoscallion (anime)
cosmoscallionanime.lore: A maiden who freely drifts around the Milky Way like a shooting star. Countless people make wishes on her, but she dryly states that real dreams are the ones you can fulfill on your own.

sportsdragonkeeperanime.title: Sportsdragon Keeper (anime)
sportsdragonkeeperanime.lore: A clutch player for the team. No matter what flies at him, he will risk his life to stop it.

femtronanime.title: Femtron (anime)
femtronanime.lore: The source of the draconic tree that holds the secret of all providence. When assailed by microcosm and macrocosm, the world will be guided to a new domain.

redeyesblackdragonanimerushduel.title: Red-Eyes Black Dragon (anime Rush Duel)
redeyesblackdragonanimerushduel.lore: A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.

harpieladyanimerushduel.title: Harpie Lady (anime Rush Duel)
harpieladyanimerushduel.lore: This human-shaped animal with wings is beautiful to watch but deadly in battle.

summonedskullanimerushduel.title: Summoned Skull (anime Rush Duel)
summonedskullanimerushduel.lore: A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.

darkmagiciananimerushduel.title: Dark Magician (anime Rush Duel)
darkmagiciananimerushduel.lore: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

spiderrollthesushifairyanime.title: Spider Roll the Sushi Fairy (anime)
spiderrollthesushifairyanime.lore: A crony of the divine beings from the Celestial Sushi Dimension. With wit and aromatic paddy-feels, decrees for rice rolls-off the tongue.

monkeyrollthesushifairyanime.title: Monkey Roll the Sushi Fairy (anime)
monkeyrollthesushifairyanime.lore: A crony of the divine beings from the Celestial Sushi Dimension. With wit and sweet paddy-feels, decrees for rice rolls-off the tongue.

kurobanatheshadowflowerwolfanime.title: Kurobana the Shadow Flower Wolf (anime)
kurobanatheshadowflowerwolfanime.lore: Lurking in the shadows to save its master of the grass clan from danger. Even after its defeat, it will return from behind the grassy knoll.

lindotheshadowflowerwarrioranime.title: Lindo the Shadow Flower Warrior (anime)
lindotheshadowflowerwarrioranime.lore: Lurking in the shadows to support its master of the grass clan in battle. There is no doubt about her dedication.

shovelcrusheranimerushduel.title: Shovel Crusher (anime Rush Duel)
shovelcrusheranimerushduel.lore: Armed with a pair of shovels, this monster will destroy anything that stands in its way.

bullbreakeranime.title: Bull Breaker (anime)
bullbreakeranime.lore: Incredibly useful on site, but the lease is exorbitant. Planning is the biggest part of the job.

unitedantsanime.title: United Ants (anime)
unitedantsanime.lore: Ants that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.

antsrunningaboutanime.title: Ants Running About (anime)
antsrunningaboutanime.lore: Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.

oppressedantanime.title: Oppressed Ant (anime)
oppressedantanime.lore: An ant who is oppressed, but believes it will have freedom someday.

constructorwarriorshovelonanime.title: Constructor Warrior Shovelon (anime)
constructorwarriorshovelonanime.lore: A young warrior. Each day he passionately uses his shovel to dig up work sites.

constructorsoldierdrillzardanime.title: Constructor Soldier Drillzard (anime)
constructorsoldierdrillzardanime.lore: A humanoid reincarnated from a dragon. His masterful strategy and deft hands help reduce construction times considerably.

mushroommananimerushduel.title: Mushroom Man (anime Rush Duel)
mushroommananimerushduel.lore: Found in humid regions, this creature attacks enemies with a lethal rain of poison spores.

cryingmoonrabbitanime.title: Crying Moon Rabbit (anime)
cryingmoonrabbitanime.lore: The days and months flowed by. Each day was full. Those really were the good old days.

bluefalcontenguanime.title: Blue Falcon Tengu (anime)
bluefalcontenguanime.lore: A ruthless tengu who leaves opponents stunned by attacking without mercy.

masakithelegendarysamuraianime.title: Masaki the Legendary Samurai (anime)
masakithelegendarysamuraianime.lore: This legendary samurai is a veteran of over a hundred battles.

tsuvolcanoanime.title: Tsuvolcano (anime)
tsuvolcanoanime.lore: Here comes a magma-hot shiatsu massage! Pressure Point Eruption!

hamperinghippoanime.title: Hampering Hippo (anime)
hamperinghippoanime.lore: A surprisingly fast hippopotamus that tries to push back any hostility. It can swim dexterously with its track belt.

barrierarmordilloanime.title: Barrier Armordillo (anime)
barrierarmordilloanime.lore: A surprisingly strong armadillo that bounces back anything close. It can dig dexterously with its track belt.

thefiredragonanime.title: The Fire Dragon (anime)
thefiredragonanime.lore: An exquisite dragon covered in fire. It does not like fights, but still has incredibly high attack power.

hitotsumegiantanimerushduel.title: Hitotsu-Me Giant (anime Rush Duel)
hitotsumegiantanimerushduel.lore: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

candanime.title: CAN:D (anime)
candanime.lore: In possession of infinite potential. Chasing her dreams with a smile that blinds.

darkhandshakeranime.title: Dark Handshaker (anime)
darkhandshakeranime.lore: [REQUIREMENT] None[EFFECT] Shuffle 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard into the [[Main Deck

greatcosmonarchanime.title: Great Cosmonarch (anime)
greatcosmonarchanime.lore: [REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.[EFFECT] This card gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

universedeaanime.title: Universe Dea (anime)
universedeaanime.lore: [REQUIREMENT] Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up [[Monster Card

sylphidraanime.title: Sylphidra (anime)
sylphidraanime.lore: An infant Dragon of the four elemental dragons. Protects the land by manipulating the atmosphere at will.

kananthesecurityguardanime.title: Kanan the Security Guard (anime)
kananthesecurityguardanime.lore: A female warrior who occupies a prison island as her primary battling grounds. She scolds with sword and shield in hand. Frequent repeaters have sent positive reviews of their awakening.

guardingmermaidanime.title: Guarding Mermaid (anime)
guardingmermaidanime.lore: An aggressive mermaid who disciplines those sent to the abyss. Frequent repeaters have sent positive reviews for forgiveness.

platnidonanime.title: Platnidon (anime)
platnidonanime.lore: A pterodactyl that loves to collect shiny objects. The shell atop of its head, is its favorite.

mysticroastmananime.title: Mystic Roastman (anime)
mysticroastmananime.lore: A horse kind of man. No one can catch up to his gorging speed.

archfiendmarmotofdeliciousnessanime.title: Archfiend Marmot of Deliciousness (anime)
archfiendmarmotofdeliciousnessanime.lore: A beaver with the fiend's sauce and plate. It attacks by shoving the top ranked meat list down your throat.

barbequeoxanime.title: Barbeque Ox (anime)
barbequeoxanime.lore: An ox monster with a fine tongue and a hefty intestine. Grills everything on a single skewer.

haniwaffleanime.title: Haniwaffle (anime)
haniwaffleanime.lore: A product developed to relieve the food shortage. Its sweet appearance and taste are drawing excited cheers.

dogulcejomontblancanime.title: Dogulce Jomont Blanc (anime)
dogulcejomontblancanime.lore: Who knew adding Mont Blanc cakes to a clay pot would grant it with a soul. The sight of them roaming the stilt houses are met with screams beyond surprise.

workerwarriornewrecruitanime.title: Worker Warrior - New Recruit (anime)
workerwarriornewrecruitanime.lore: A novice drone that continues to update itself through trial & error. Frantically on the clock.

workerwarriorbadbossanime.title: Worker Warrior - Bad Boss (anime)
workerwarriorbadbossanime.lore: A mid-level drone that spends most of its memory fighting for promotions. Its reports are a storm of peer-to-peer slander.

constructordemolisherwyrmdrakecrushanime.title: Constructor Demolisher Wyrm Drake Crush (anime)
constructordemolisherwyrmdrakecrushanime.lore: A Constructor Wyrm enveloped in specialized construction gear. It is said that no matter the size of the project, the wyrm could demolish the site in one blow.

royalrebelsnowaveanime.title: Royal Rebel's No Wave (anime)
royalrebelsnowaveanime.lore: A deformed fiend under servitude to the king. It swallows all sound and deflects all bombardment.

sunnyfairyspinangelanime.title: Sunny Fairy Spinangel (anime)
sunnyfairyspinangelanime.lore: An angel living it up in the present progressive tense. No one can stop this maaan.

cycliptronanime.title: Cycliptron (anime)
cycliptronanime.lore: The keystone of the Sky Emperor, bestowed with the providence of all existence. By breaking through its constraints, it is born anew to break new ground.

dolphinkingiruquaanime.title: Dolphin King Iruqua (anime)
dolphinkingiruquaanime.lore: A dolphin that has braved the stormy seas and hardships of the world, throwing itself headfirst into learning the ways of royalty.

gagagaoutfielderanime.title: Gagaga Outfielder (anime)
gagagaoutfielderanime.lore: A baseball warrior with gutsy defense and surprising hitting range. Also known as the fence magician, he is remembered visually rather than statistically.

achachacatcheranime.title: Achacha Catcher (anime)
achachacatcheranime.lore: A baseball warrior with a deft lead and an arrow-like delivery. Also known as the bedrock, he leads his teammates with his passionate play style.

decenniummysticswordanime.title: Decennium Mystic Sword (anime)
decenniummysticswordanime.lore: A sword with a soul. It is said that those who held this sword had begun training for an inevitable battle.

oneyearbroomanime.title: One Year Broom (anime)
oneyearbroomanime.lore: A broom with a soul. It is said that whoever wields this broom will begin to work harder towards their goals.

millenniumshieldanimerushduel.title: Millennium Shield (anime Rush Duel)
millenniumshieldanimerushduel.lore: A famous shield said to belong to an ancient Egyptian Pharaoh. Legends tell of its power to block any strong attack.

centennialwoodenbladeanime.title: Centennial Wooden Blade (anime)
centennialwoodenbladeanime.lore: A wooden sword with a soul. It had passed through the hands of various souls and had witnessed the rise and fall of a century.

imaginaryactoranime.title: Imaginary Actor (anime)
imaginaryactoranime.lore: A mechanical doll that has no emotional expression other than a smile. The emotional response from the audience is its main source of energy.

sworddanceranime.title: Sword Dancer (anime)
sworddanceranime.lore: A skilled swordsmen that had once served a powerful nation. His sword flies through with unrivaled precision as the crowd holds their breath.

celticguardiananimerushduel.title: Celtic Guardian (anime Rush Duel)
celticguardiananimerushduel.lore: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

gazellethekingofmythicalbeastsanimerushd.title: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts (anime Rush Duel)
gazellethekingofmythicalbeastsanimerushd.en: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts (anime Rush Duel)
gazellethekingofmythicalbeastsanimerushd.lore: This monster moves so fast that it looks like an illusion to mortal eyes.

royalrebelsbabybassanime.title: Royal Rebel's Babybass (anime)
royalrebelsbabybassanime.lore: A bass fiend that coolly supports Beginitar and Kidrum.

royalrebelskidrumanime.title: Royal Rebel's Kidrum (anime)
royalrebelskidrumanime.lore: A drum fiend that started a band because it admired the greater Royal Rebels.

royalrebelsbeginitaranime.title: Royal Rebel's Beginitar (anime)
royalrebelsbeginitaranime.lore: A guitar fiend that works hard every day to get everyone to hear its songs.

thedragonanime.title: The Dragon (anime)
thedragonanime.lore: A dragon of justice that makes you envision a supernova clash! The name is, The Dragon!

serpainteranime.title: Serpainter (anime)
serpainteranime.lore: A marvelous dragon that lives beneath the clear waters. He is now the popular mascot of a circus.

pluggyfishanime.title: Pluggyfish (anime)
pluggyfishanime.lore: An organism formed from jellyfish and electrical plugs. It is an ecological enigma.

needlkyriethecelestialseamstressanime.title: Needlkyrie the Celestial Seamstress (anime)
needlkyriethecelestialseamstressanime.lore: A messenger who illuminates the way to the higher realm. Darkness flees against the light of the chosen.

dreamladybugrainbowanime.title: Dream Ladybug Rainbow (anime)
dreamladybugrainbowanime.lore: The star on its back is the trademark for this emotional ladybug. Today, it delivers joy and rainbow trails to all.

frenziedpandacottaanime.title: Frenzied Panda Cotta (anime)
frenziedpandacottaanime.lore: A ferocious panda chef. Gets quite upset when you order Panna Cotta.

changeofdessertanime.title: Change of Dessert (anime)
